title: Redirects made when an address changes
problem: Renaming a product or page broke every old link to it (review ON-F19).
now: A live item's old address redirects to the new one by itself; loops and chains are flagged.
steps: Rename a live product and save.
Open SEO › Redirects: old → new is listed.
Open the old address: it lands on the product.

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
